articles.title: ROBINHOOD BRINGS US IPO ACCESS TO UK RETAIL INVESTORS
articles.summary: UK customers can request shares in eligible US IPOs at the official offer price before trading begins, through general investment accounts and with no commission. Robinhood says it has worked on more than 50 IPOs in the US since 2021 and is using a UK Public Offer Platform provider. The launch follows its August UK crypto rollout via Bitstamp and the July mainnet launch of Robinhood Chain.

articles.title: BITCOIN TRADES BELOW STRATEGY'S $75,451 AVERAGE PURCHASE PRICE
articles.summary: Strategy's 849,327 BTC holdings slipped into unrealized loss territory over the weekend, with the position valued at roughly $63.58 billion against a $64.08 billion total acquisition cost at an average purchase price of $75,451 per coin. The move puts Saylor's leveraged accumulation thesis under pressure at a price level that has become the largest corporate Bitcoin holder's de facto breakeven floor.

articles.title: WALRASWAP: EQUILIBRIUM-BASED DEX INTEGRATING EXTERNAL LIQUIDITY
articles.summary: Walraswap proposes an equilibrium-based batch DEX that integrates external AMM liquidity, where a price vector exists such that all submitted orders execute with no token deficit or surplus. Unlike CoW Swap, UniswapX, and 1inch Fusion, which use uniform clearing prices alone, Walraswap's equilibrium property requires including all available trade orders, closing the solver manipulation vector where order censorship shifts clearing outcomes. DAO-elected solvers retain censorship as the sole attack surface, which the protocol treats as detectable in a repeated game (analogous to block builders not unbundling searcher bundles). The construction, originating at Flashbots in 2023, frames settlement as a convex optimization problem. Net trades at equilibrium are unique despite non-unique price vectors.

articles.title: BLOCK TIME AND PROPAMMS: FROM ETHEREUM TO BASE DENIM
articles.summary: PropAMMs face a core execution risk: the gap between an onchain quoted price and the live market rate spans one block, letting fast traders extract value at the maker's expense during that window. On Ethereum's 12-second blocks, builders such as Titan address this by guaranteeing a maker's latest price update lands before any competing trade in the same block, a mechanism Flashbots is standardizing as ERC-8324 and that Fermi has used to process hundreds of millions in weekly DEX volume. Base's Denim upgrade converts each 200ms flashblock slot into a full block, retiring the preview layer, shrinking the staleness window from 2 seconds to 200ms, and giving aggregators and solvers fresher quotes up to 2 seconds sooner. For propAMM operators, Denim makes per-block exposure limits more precise and shifts the execution advantage from tip size to sequencer latency, a dynamic Biconomy has been testing with a major market maker on its own Base propAMM since October.

I CHECKED 646 CRYPTO CARDS AND RANKED THE 109 THAT MATTER
articles.summary: Kseilas found that only 256 of 646 cards are live and available to regular users, and scored 109 on cost (30%), cashback (25%), safety (20%), access (15%), and daily use (10%), with data as of November 8. Four cards reached S tier: ether.fi Cash (78.5), Solid (78.0), Ethena Pay (77.8), and Jupiter (73.0). ether.fi pays 3% on the first $2,000 a month in its own ETHFI token, Solid pays up to 3% in USDC capped at $50 a month, Ethena Pay pays 4% in AVAX on the first $2,500, and Jupiter pays 2% in USDC. OKX is best for travel with no FX fee in the EU, and Coinbase One is the pick for a Bitcoin credit card. Headline rates usually carry conditions such as own-token payouts, staking, or large balances.

articles.title: AGENTIC COMMERCE: 17 MONTHS LATER
articles.summary: Seventeen months after the original agentic commerce piece, all three predictions are holding: payment processors with identity and tokenization infrastructure (Stripe, PayPal, and Adyen) are capturing early value, consumers still want final authentication control, and checkout is evolving rather than dying as purchase origination shifts from brand search to AI engines and social. The Agentic Commerce Protocol (Stripe and OpenAI) and Stripe Link Balance both launched in the interim, moving the thesis from prediction to live infrastructure. Shah's strongest current conviction is that agentic commerce creates more capacity for SMEs than convenience for consumers, with agents automating operations and cash flow management in place of headcount. The economic model for hybrid stablecoin and card-rail settlement remains unresolved.

articles.title: WHERE ONCHAIN CREDIT FITS IN THE AI BOOM
articles.summary: AI compute is now a debt business, with 110 public GPU financings totaling $197B since 2023, mostly led by big banks that only serve borrowers large enough to justify diligence. That leaves small neoclouds underserved, and USD.AI lends to them from stablecoin deposits against GPUs as collateral, at 10-15% rates (12% median) versus 9-10% fixed at banks, and says loans can clear in under 7 days. It has originated $531M across 20 financings, and its sUSDai vault targets a 7% yield. The new GLX program sells seasoned loans so the cash can be re-lent, and the first exit was the $98.1M Duos Edge AI loan, repaid within four months. CHIP buybacks are funded by the protocol's 10% cut of interest, and onchain lenders hold under 1% of the $48.4B GPU debt raised in 2026. Risks include fast GPU depreciation, neocloud consolidation, and a mismatch between 30-day withdrawals and roughly 3-year loans.

articles.title: BRIAN ARMSTRONG'S THREE-TIER AGENT WORKFLOW
articles.summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong restructured his executive workflow around a three-tier agent hierarchy: a chief of staff agent overseeing per-domain lead agents, which each manage sub-agents for code, testing, and team coordination. All decisions and reviews funnel into a single prioritized queue with screenshots and video demos per feature, cleared in batches by voice and keyboard shortcuts. The system builds a model of his preferences over time, with first drafts and recommendations improving before they reach him, targeting fewer corrections per change. Armstrong frames this as a live example of the agent-economy infrastructure Coinbase is building.
